courses.summary: 英比雙向天然氣互聯管線是本課引用官方資料的真實工程背景。研究焦點為雙向流動時能量帳與方向符號的改變；課程把公開可確認的地理與項目身分，和自行建立的物料、能量、庫存及故障診斷情境分開，要求學徒逐項提交計算、假設、驗證資料與適用範圍。
courses.summaryEn: Interconnector UK is the real engineering context identified by the official source. The study focuses on energy accounting and sign changes during bidirectional transport, separating verified project identity and geography from authored material, energy, inventory and diagnostic scenarios. Learners submit calculations, assumptions, validation evidence and applicability limits.
